factoryPresets.captureMethod: Actual production JUCE editor snapshots with direct readback of each visible OpenGL surface's presented front buffer on its GL thread, vertically oriented and composited at its real clipped editor bounds. Separate GPU PNG files retain native physical resolution. Gallery cards are illustrative previews.
factoryPresets.sourceFixture: Original procedural stereo music, twelve seconds of live editor warmup, then frozen measured PCM and meter history for all look comparisons.

benchmarks.name: stereo-raster
benchmarks.definition: Same 64 retained traces of 1024 points, 256x256 raster. Baseline repeats the old brightness registry lookup per pixel; optimized path calls production rebuildStereo. Pixels verified byte-identical.

benchmarks.name: spectrogram-full-rebuild
benchmarks.definition: 480x256 retained spectral image. Baseline uses original per-row range lookups with an existing LUT; production rebuild additionally refreshes the LUT and appearance signature. Pixels verified byte-identical.

benchmarks.name: spectrogram-unchanged-appearance
benchmarks.definition: Full production rebuild versus production early-return for unchanged appearance and retained history. Cache identity and output verified; no per-frame history rasterization is needed.

editorPerformance.measurementScope: Bounded CPU-only production editor cache/raster tests; timings are local observations, not a real-time audio or end-to-end frame-rate guarantee.

surfaceBaseline.method: Production VisualSurface; 720x450 logical pixels; 30 frames per scene; glFinish wall time; synthetic input; no audio device
surfaceBaseline.baselineMethod: When --baseline is set, reproduce the previous unused PearlFlow updates before each non-Pearl scene. All other rendering uses the same current production path.
